jobs.title: GIS ANALYST
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------


Are you ready to turn data into insight and help shape smarter decisions through the power of GIS? We are seeking a talented and motivated GIS Analyst to join our team and apply geospatial technology, data analysis, and problem\-solving skills to meaningful, real\-world challenges.


The GIS Analyst serves as a primary point of collaboration between the Information Technology Department's GIS team and Town departments. Reporting to the Enterprise Applications Manager, this position is responsible for understanding departmental GIS data and workflow needs, and designing solutions including integrations, web applications, dashboards, and automated processes. The GIS Analyst works closely with departmental GIS specialists to support the data needs of the broader organization and helps translate business requirements into effective GIS solutions.


If this work inspires you, we invite you to apply today. Join our team where your technical expertise, creativity, and perspective will be valued and where the work you do will make a measurable difference. Bring your ideas, your analytical mindset, and your enthusiasm for geospatial technology, and help us build smarter solutions for the future.

**Anticipate Hiring Range: $98,000 \- $110,000**
**Typical Tasks**
-----------------


Departmental Solution Design \& Consultation

* Engage with Town departments to assess current GIS workflows, identify needs, and define requirements for GIS solutions.
* Design and develop GIS solutions including web maps, applications, dashboards, and automated workflows tailored to departmental business processes.
* Build and publish ArcGIS Experience Builder, ArcGIS Dashboards, and ArcGIS Story Maps applications to support departmental needs.
* Consult with departmental GIS specialists on data collection, editing workflows, and feature service design.
* Document business requirements, solution designs, and user guidance for deployed GIS applications.


Integration \& Process Development

* Design and develop integrations between ArcGIS services and departmental business systems, including permitting, work order, asset management, and customer service platforms.
* Develop automated data processing workflows using Python, ArcPy, ArcGIS API for Python, and Arcade expressions.
* Create and maintain feature services, hosted layers, and related GIS content in ArcGIS Enterprise Portal.
* Develop Survey123 forms and Field Maps configurations to support departmental field data collection workflows.


Spatial Analysis \& Data Products

* Perform spatial analysis to support decision\-making across Town departments, including planning, public works, utilities, and public safety.
* Develop and maintain printed and interactive maps, data visualizations, and reporting products that communicate GIS data clearly to varied audiences.
* Create and maintain spatial datasets and maintain cartographic standards for departmental map products.
* Support ad hoc mapping and analysis requests from departments throughout the organization.


Data Standards \& Coordination

* Work with departmental GIS specialists to ensure data collection and editing practices align with organizational GIS data standards.
* Assist the GIS Administrator in reviewing and validating data submissions prior to publication in the enterprise geodatabase.
* Provide training and technical guidance to departmental GIS specialists on GIS tools, workflows, and organizational standards.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of GIS documentation, user guides, and standard operating procedures.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**
-----------------------------------


* Proficiency with Esri ArcGIS Pro for spatial analysis, cartography, and data management.
* Experience building web GIS applications using ArcGIS Enterprise Portal, ArcGIS Experience Builder, Dashboards, and related products.
* Working knowledge of ArcGIS Online and Portal for ArcGIS content management.
* Ability to develop Python scripts using ArcPy and ArcGIS API for Python for data processing and automation.
* Familiarity with Esri field data collection tools including Survey123andField Maps.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into GIS solutions.
* Effective interpersonal and communication skills; ability to work collaboratively with non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritize work effectively.
* Knowledge of GIS data formats, coordinate systems, and spatial data quality concepts.

**Minimum and Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------------------


Any combination of education and experience equivalent to graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Urban Planning, Computer Science, or a closely related field. Candidate must also have the following:

* Three (3\) or more years of professional experience working with ArcGIS software in an enterprise GIS environment.
* Two (2\) or more years of experience developing GIS web applications or automated workflows.
* Two (2\) or more years of experience consulting with or supporting end users on GIS tools and workflows.

  

Preferred Qualifications:

* Esri Technical Certification (e.g., ArcGIS Desktop Entry/Associate, ArcGIS Web Application Developer).
* Two (2\) or more years of experience working in a government GIS environment across local, state, or federal agencies.
* One (1\) or more years of experience with Esri Survey123 Connect or ArcGIS Field Maps.
* Two (2\) or more years of experience with ArcGIS Notebooks or Jupyter Notebooks for geospatial data analysis.
* One (1\) or more years of experience with JavaScript, HTML/CSS, or the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript for custom application development.

  

Physical Requirements:

* An employee must be able to talk and hear

jobs.title: GIS Analyst II - Information Technology (0826)
jobs.description:
**Nature of Work**
------------------


Under general supervision, performs work of moderate difficulty in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) management, including database design; ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Online administration; data maintenance; data analysis and interpretation; modeling support; application development; and project management; other duties as assigned.


Occasional after\-hours work may be required to address urgent issues, perform system maintenance, or implement planned upgrades. Establishing and following best practices for user support and system changes is critical to maintaining operational efficiency. This position also requires close collaboration with other Information Technology support teams to ensure seamless integration and effective problem resolution across different technical areas.

**Work Arrangement:** **This is an in\-office position. Limited remote work may be authorized on an occasional basis, subject to operational needs, and requires prior approval from the Deputy Chief Information Officer or Chief Information Officer.**

 **Background Requirement: This position will require the successful completion of a Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) fingerprint and background clearance within 90 days of employment; this must be maintained throughout employment.**

  


**Typical Duties**
------------------


* Designs, develops, programs, and supports integrated GIS systems
* Designs and implements custom web applications for internal and public use within ArcGIS Online, helps to administer organizational items and members
* Provides oversight and management for large projects
* Utilizes various software and extensions to perform complex GIS analysis
* Utilizes various programming languages like Python and SQL in support of ETL processes
* Works closely with GIS staff and departments to understand business needs, prepares technical specifications, and recommends options to stakeholders
* Researches and implements new technologies and methodologies for GIS solutions in coordination with the GIS Manager; documents processes and procedures
* Assists in administering server infrastructure within an ArcGIS Enterprise deployment, and troubleshooting errors that may occur
* May be asked to be on call during emergency events

*Essential functions include but are not limited to: sitting and performing repetitive hand and wrist motions for data analysis and computer work; working with other staff and county departments; working effectively in a remote office environment; and communicating in both routine conversation and technical presentations*
**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


Bachelor's degree in geography, urban planning, environmental science, or related field, and four years of progressively responsible experience with Geographical Information Systems, programming, systems analysis, or integration and management, OR


Associate degree in geography, urban planning, environmental science, or related field, and five years of progressively responsible experience with Geographical Information Systems, programming, systems analysis, or integration and management, OR


Six years of progressively responsible experience with Geographical Information Systems, programming, systems analysis, or integration and management, OR


Any equivalent combination of education, training and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the duties of the position.


This position is non\-exempt from overtime.


The **ideal candidate** will contribute to the successful delivery of Enterprise GIS services and will have proven experience designing and deploying enterprise\-wide solutions using the full ArcGIS Enterprise platform. This includes development and implementation of GIS tools, add\-ins, and web\-based applications; supporting the administration and configuration of Esri’s enterprise deployment, including ArcSDE, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Portal, and ArcGIS Online; and creating customized geospatial solutions within ArcGIS Enterprise environments. This work relies heavily on application programming languages such as Python and Arcade within ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online applications.


This position provides support to a variety of internal and external clients and offers a diverse range of daily work activities based on client needs. The candidate will be responsible for managing multiple projects simultaneously and must maintain high levels of professional conduct and work quality. Example duties may include designing, implementing, and debugging complex GIS\-centric applications and database solutions; functioning as a database administrator; serving as an ArcGIS Online administrator; providing user training; and developing system documentation and instructional materials.

**Preferred qualifications** include experience building and maintaining mapping applications using Esri’s ArcGIS desktop and online platforms; managing and administering spatial and non\-spatial data within traditional and branch versioned SDE databases; and installing, configuring, customizing, administering, and maintaining an Enterprise GIS system, including ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Portal, and ArcGIS Online.


Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot problems and develop both short\-term and long\-term solutions; to create and use automated processes with ModelBuilder, Python, and/or other automation tools; to manage multiple projects while meeting tight deadlines; to establish and maintain effective working relationships with a variety of individuals and groups, including customers in stressful situations; and to work collaboratively with GIS and IT peers. Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with all levels of the organization, including conducting public presentations and GIS training. jobs.title: Assistant Planner / Scheduler
jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

The Assistant Planner/Scheduler will work closely with our planning and scheduling team to assist our preconstruction, project management, field teams, and subcontractors to aid in the development and management of project schedules to ensure the success of our projects. **Responsibilities and Essential Duties include the following** (other duties may be assigned):* Assist with the overall development of detailed project schedule
* Assist in collecting project progress and updating project status
* Work with the project management and senior scheduling team to help set project goals and analyze the status of the project
* Assist in analysis of schedules to determine duration and logic issues
* Perform other duties as assigned
* Travel and/or relocation may be necessary depending on the project needs and location


Education \- Skills \- Knowledge \- Qualifications \& Experience:
**Education/Qualifications/Experience/Skills:*** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction, Architecture, or other related program
* Work experience in the construction industry preferred
* Experience with P6 preferred
* Learning mindset and aptitude towards growing construction knowledge
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Willingness to work hard and handle significant responsibility

*The above description covers the principal duties and responsibilities of the job. The description shall not, however, be construed as a complete listing of all miscellaneous, incidental, or similar duties which may be required from day\-to\-day. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. EOE/Vets/Disabilities*

* Assist in collecting project progress and updating project status
* Work with the project management and senior scheduling team to help set project goals and analyze the status of the project
* Assist in analysis of schedules to determine duration and logic issues
* Perform other duties as assigned
* Travel and/or relocation may be necessary depending on the project needs and location

* Work experience in the construction industry preferred
* Experience with P6 preferred
* Learning mindset and aptitude towards growing construction knowledge
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Willingness to work hard and handle significant responsibility
